instruction: Extract all slide titles from the Dickinson_Slides.pptx on my Desktop and save them to a plain text file called 'titles.txt' on the Desktop, one title per line.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully extracted speaker notes from Dickinson_Slides.pptx using python-pptx and python-docx libraries, saving them as notes.docx on the Desktop.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can write and execute Python scripts using pptx library, create output files, use terminal commands
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model proved it can use python-pptx to extract presentation data, this variation tests extracting slide titles instead of notes - a related but different extraction task.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads /home/user/Desktop/titles.txt and returns lines. Metric compares each line against expected slide titles with partial credit per title.

scoring_breakdown.per_title: 1/9 per correctly matched title in order

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/Desktop/titles.txt from the VM and returns non-empty stripped lines, which is the right state for this task.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter for type='rule' — accesses expected.get('expected_titles') directly without wrapping in expected['rules'].
Metric implements positional case-insensitive comparison with partial credit (1/9 per title), which is appropriate for ordered title extraction.
Full instruction coverage: the task requires extracting titles and saving to a file, and the evaluator checks the file content against expected titles.

Minor concern: getter filters empty lines (line.strip()), which could cause positional misalignment if any slide has an empty or missing title — subsequent titles would shift up and fail positional matching.

Minor concern: expected titles contain generic-looking names ('Presentation Title' x3, 'GraphTitle', 'Slide Title' x2) that resemble slide layout placeholder names rather than meaningful content titles. Cannot verify correctness without access to the actual PPTX file.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider handling slides with empty/missing titles by including empty strings in expected_titles rather than filtering them out, to preserve positional alignment.
Verify that expected_titles match the actual title placeholder text in Dickinson_Slides.pptx to ensure correctness.
